result:
If I could change the snacks available at movie theaters, I would make them healthier and more sustainable.

Specifically, I would replace sugary popcorn with a variety of popped grains that are lower in sugar and higher in fiber. For example, popped quinoa or popped millet could be offered.

For the candy bars, I would choose ones that are organic, fair-trade, and have less added sugar. 

This change would not only make the experience of watching a movie healthier for the audience, but it would also promote more sustainable and ethical snack options.
